entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF-881-C9B4.

Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 18th. So you've had it for about 30 days. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band?
It's just not what I wanted. It's really hard to use and the app is confusing.
I'm sorry to hear you're finding it difficult. Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I don't know if it's broken. I just know I read the user manual and it makes no sense. I really expected more for the price.
I understand. Well, let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, Sarah, I've checked our policy. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Once our warehouse receives the item, we will issue a full refund to your original method of payment. You should see that reflected in your account within 3 to 5 business days after we get it.
Whatever. It would have been nice to know that from the start.
I apologize for any inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a good rest of your day.
